description: Celebrate the holiday season with a special 20th Anniversary presentation of The Holiday in Concert, live at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood on November 27. Experience the beloved 2006 romantic comedy like never before as the complete film plays on a cinema-size HD screen while a live orchestra performs its enchanting score in perfect sync. Starring Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law, and Jack Black, The Holiday follows two women living 6,000 miles apart who swap homes for Christmas and unexpectedly find themselves exactly where they need to be. name: DAVID BENOIT: A CHARLIE BROWN CHRISTMAS (Grammy Award-nominated Pianist, KJAZZ Host)
description: David Benoit's Christmas Tribute to Charlie Brown In 1965, the first ever , "rdquo" -> Peanuts" animated special took place. It was a landmark event and it was the start of a tradition that would continue year after year. , "rdquo" -> A Charlie Brown Christmas" is a tradition enjoyed around the world by fans of all ages. Now, over 50 years later, Contemporary Jazz Piano Legend, David Benoit along with distinguished Vocalist, Courtney Fortune, is paying tribute to this incredible piece of entertainment history, with a , "rdquo" -> David Benoit Christmas Tribute to Charlie Brown With Special Guest Courtney Fortune". This inspirational tribute concert features the classic music of Vince Guaraldi along with , "rdquo" -> Charlie Brown Christmas" originals from David Benoit, who took over the helm as music composer for the new Charlie Brown Christmas TV Specials more than a decade ago, as well as classics from David Benoit's illustrious career as a Multi-Grammy Nominated Solo Artist. The show also features the young voices of a local children's choir, which serves as a wonderful way of getting the local community involved. The heart-warming show is sure to get the audience in that Christmas Spirit and bring out the'kid' in all of us this holiday season.
